title: Machine Learning Strategies for Preoperative PJI Diagnosis: Integrative Analysis of Serum and Synovial Fluid Markers.
summary: Using serum and synovial-fluid markers from 376 revision-surgery patients, the study trained eight machine-learning models for preoperative periprosthetic-joint-infection diagnosis. XGBoost achieved AUC 0.998 in the test set and was compared with MSIS 2013 and ICM 2018 criteria in an external cohort. The study reports diagnostic performance, not improved patient outcomes. The result is reported in Journal of Inflammation Research. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
